ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the photo, the undulating mountain body of the Qilian Mountains can be seen. Bright white ice and snow patches are mainly concentrated on one side of the mountain body, while the adjacent other side of the slope is darker in color, with little snow or basically no snow, showing an obvious one-sided distribution. Reasoning: The stem states that the time is mid-August and the location is the Qilian Mountains. This is a spatial difference of summer alpine ice and snow on different slope aspects. In mountains, if one side has significantly more ice, snow, and accumulated snow, it usually indicates that this side is subject to the frontal uplift of moist air currents, with more precipitation or snowfall, and the accumulated snow is easier to preserve. Therefore, the side on which the ice and snow are concentrated in the figure belongs to the windward slope.

raw_record.question_text:
A traveler in mid-August 2013 took a plane departing at 18:30 from Xi'an to Urumqi. The figure below is a photo taken by the traveler when passing over the Qilian Mountains.

<image1>

The ice and snow in the figure are distributed only on one side of the mountain. What slope does this side belong to?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中冰雪只集中在山体一侧、另一侧少雪或无雪；再读取题干中地点为祁连山、时间为8月中旬，说明这是夏季高山冰雪的空间差异。将这种一侧积雪明显更多的现象与山地降水规律相连：多雪侧说明受湿润气流抬升影响，降雪、积雪多，因此该侧属于迎风坡。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：照片中可见祁连山山体起伏，亮白色的冰雪斑块主要集中在山体的一侧，而相邻的另一侧山坡颜色较暗，少雪或基本无雪，呈现出明显的单侧分布。
推理：题干说明时间为8月中旬，地点为祁连山，这是夏季高山冰雪在不同坡向上的空间差异。山地中某一侧冰雪、积雪明显更多，通常说明该侧受到湿润气流迎面抬升，降水或降雪较多，积雪更容易保留。因此，图中冰雪集中分布的这一侧属于迎风坡。

planner_metadata.image_role: 先观察照片：航拍山地中，白色冰雪斑块明显集中在若干山脊、山坡的同一侧，另一侧大多呈暗色裸露山坡，基本无雪；图中还有方位指示，但本问主要利用冰雪分布的不对称性。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 山地迎风坡上，湿润气流被迫抬升，气温降低，水汽凝结，降水和降雪较多；背风坡下沉增温、较干燥，积雪较少。夏季仍能保留较多冰雪的一侧通常是降水、积雪条件更好的迎风坡。
